Well, it's not something I've done personally, but I've read about interesting examples in the field. In one study, a teacher assigned virtual nicknames to her students based on their learning styles. For instance, one student was nicknamed "The Explorer" because they loved delving deep into topics.

This simple action had profound psychological effects. Students felt more recognized and valued, which boosted their self-esteem and motivation. They also felt a stronger connection with the teacher and each other, fostering a more engaging learning environment. So, while it might seem trivial, giving students virtual nicknames can have significant psychological implications.
